chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 0377: Ji Ning Obliterates Three Firewing Centipedes in One Strike – Betrayal & Karma
chapter_meta_description: The Qi royalty betrays Ji Ning, sealing him inside a formation with hundreds of demon soldiers. But they gravely underestimate his power—a single sword-light annihilates three Loose Immortals and their entire army. Karma strikes fast.
og_title: One Sword, Three Centipedes, Zero Survivors – Desolate Era 0377
og_description: The Qi royalty trap Ji Ning with three thousand-zhang Firewing Centipedes, hoping to buy time. They get a brutal lesson in what happens when you double-cross a Sword Immortal.
twitter_title: Chapter 0377: That One Strike Was Absolutely Savage
twitter_description: The Firewing Guards thought numbers would save them. They were wrong. Ji Ning’s sword doesn’t negotiate.

lore_anchors.definition: An elite demon army under the Firewing Demon King, equipped with dao-soldier armor that allows them to combine their power into a giant Firewing Centipede formation.
A thousand-zhang-long monster formed by a dao-soldier formation; wings of fire and a centipede body, representing a unified fighting unit of hundreds of demon soldiers.
Magical armor inscribed with runes that allows multiple soldiers to merge their strength, forming projections of large beasts for joint attacks and defense.
A cultivator who failed the Celestial Tribulation and survived via an incomplete method; they are immortal but face periodic tribulations, and are generally weaker than a true Celestial Immortal.
The fifth major realm of Ki Refining, where the cultivator births a Primal soul (Yuanshen), gaining telepathic control of treasures and powerful divine sense.
The fourth major realm of Ki Refining, meaning “Myriad Manifestations,” where the Violet Palace develops stars, sun, and moon for vastly accelerated energy absorption.
The deepest, most fundamental core of a being’s soul; destroying the truesoul prevents any form of reincarnation, representing absolute, irreversible death.
A legendary cursed river in the Star Continent that suppresses flight and Five Elements escape techniques within a thousand li, acting as a geographical equalizer.
A unit of length; one zhang is approximately 3.3 meters; a thousand-zhang is about 3.3 kilometers, used to emphasize the immense scale of the Firewing Centipede manifestation.
The surviving prince and princesses of the fallen Qi Kingdom, fleeing across the Evil Dragon River territory under the protection of Ji Ning.
